name: Na source-process kernel verification
purpose: Verify the compiled Na impact-vaporization normalization and PSD energy-density kernel, prove that the M0 input registers the built-in impact source once while the historical MySource alias is disabled, and verify the exact input-driven Tenishev-2013 Case-1 source receipt.
production_capability: Exosphere ImpactVaporization and PhotonStimulatedDesorption source kernels plus the optional Tenishev-2013 Case-1 runtime source adapter.
configuration: Legacy moon.input values remain 1.69e22 s^-1, beta=0.7 and U=0.052 eV. The optional committed Tenishev-2013 Case-1 receipt requires 1.67e22 s^-1, 6000 K, 129600 s illuminated lifetime, 2.65e16 m^-2 prescribed reservoir, complete sticking, 100+300*cos(chi)^0.25 K, 500-step samples and a 5000-step cap.
independent_reference: Direct source-rate and PSD formula evaluation.
units: s^-1, J at API boundary, eV inside documented PSD formula
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic rate/density kernels; distribution sampling requires a later seeded test.
procedure: Check the maintained input and generated definition for the confirmed source-selection modes, invoke compiled legacy production functions, parse and install the committed Case-1 input, install the same runtime callbacks used by production, and compare the declared rate, temperature, lifetime, reservoir, temperature-law and bounded-run values.
acceptance_criteria: The legacy input selects built-in impact on and MySource off; the generated user-source mode is off; formula values are within 1e-14 relative; the Case-1 parser and runtime callbacks reproduce every exact declared scalar and prescribed-uniform mode.
expected_pass_result: The M0 source selection remains unchanged and the optional exact Case-1 receipt reaches the ordinary runtime source callbacks without using legacy compiled rate/temperature constants.
data_hashes: none; this is formula/config verification, not source validation
status_semantics: PASS proves the M0 source-selection invariant, deterministic source formulas, and Case-1 parser/callback scalars only. It does not prove linked particle statistics, equilibrium, convergence, the prescribed-reservoir exchange path, or observational agreement; those remain integration/validation work.
